hypothesis: H1: a liquidity taker who buys NO at a cost basis inside the frozen band (within 90-99 cents) and holds to resolution earns a positive mean return per dollar at risk, net of taker fees.

price_normalization.rule: if yes_price + no_price == 99 then yes_cost = 100 - no_price and no_cost = 100 - yes_price, else the stored prices

holdA.note: through the end of local data (last trade 2025-11-25 22:00 UTC); semi-blind

holdB.window: [live-endpoint trades cutoff from GET /historical/cutoff at pull time, pull start)
holdB.reverse_purge: drop holdB events that have any trade in train, val or holdA

purge.rule: keep each event only in the latest split containing any of its trades; flag its rows in earlier splits purged=true

fees.model: taker fee per order, cents = ceil(100 * coef * multiplier * C * P * (1 - P)), P = cost_cents / 100

series_multipliers.source: Kalshi, 'We're Halving the Fees for Our S&P and Nasdaq Markets', 2022-09-14, effective 2022-09-22

grid.order: band (outer), then category_filter, then liquidity_floor, each in the listed order

entry.rule: first taker row with direction = no, cost_cents in band, category and liquidity filters passing, not purged, timestamp inside the split window

selection.validation_rule: keep configs with validation mean_net_ret > 0; choose the highest validation t_event; none -> 'Not supported (failed validation)'

stats.mean_test: event-clustered SE = sqrt(G/(G-1) * sum_g (sum_{i in g} (r_i - rbar))^2) / n; t = rbar / SE; one-sided H1: mean > 0
stats.p_value: one-sided Student t with G - 1 degrees of freedom
stats.market_clustered_se: same formula with each market as its own cluster

deflated_sharpe.sr_variance_from: train per-entry Sharpe ratios of all 12 configs
